notes.title: 🌟 Location contest: "Pimp your club!"
notes.content:
A mega creative interior design contest is announced:
🌟 "Pimp your club!"

Want to create an epicenter of style and unforgettable meetings for your group of friends? Then this contest is your chance to make a name for yourself!

👉 Your mission: Develop a unique and ultra-creative interior design for a club space that will become the perfect place for your friends to hang out and socialize. The bolder and more original your idea is, the brighter and more attractive the realization will be, the higher your chances to win over the jury!

Important! Technical requirements:
 * All images, textures and videos used in the project must be uploaded and stored in the texture organizer of the game server, in the "my textures" section.

 * It is strictly forbidden to use free locations "empty loft in the rock" and "Premium apartment", as well as designer (from the section "custom") locations from the real estate store.

How will the winner be determined?
There will be no voting!
The best project will be chosen by the contest administration, evaluating creativity, originality, functionality and compliance with technical requirements.

What's in store for you? Cool prizes!
💰 Absolutely all participants will receive a guaranteed prize of 250 gold coins!
🏆 3 best locations (according to the jury) will get additional 500 gold coins!
 * The best projects will not just be marked - they will become part of the game world! Your creations will be added to the world map and the real estate store, and you will receive 20% of all sales of your created objects!

 This is your chance to become famous and earn money!
Don't miss your chance to create a legendary place and make your talent known! Dare, create, surprise!
Applications for participation should be submitted in our discord in the section "Contest"
Works will be accepted until May 5 (inclusive).
Awarding of winners: May 6.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842944/ba731565c9e86e2035452579125bc4118bddffcc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 🌟 Dance game at your location! ⬆️⬅️⬇️➡️
notes.content:
🎉 Now you can organize dance competitions yourself!
✨ Dance battle for teams and singles! Buy a dance game and install it in any of your locations!
It's simple:
- Install the game in the location
- Arrange the dance places as you wish (as shown in the video).
Important: the dots on the circles are marks that indicate which way the player will look.
Only one dance game can be set up in one location, the others will not function.
*
🕺 Instructions for starting the game 💃🏽:
Click on the "Joystick" icon in the left menu. Select the dance game.
Set the settings:
✔ Speed Mode
✔ Number of arrows
✔ Type of dance (1, 2, 3)
 -> Next, click the invite button -> Select the checkboxes in the list of participants -> Start!
When all players have finished the dance you should click on the "Stop" button.

🙂 Smiley faces above the participants will tell the audience whether he/she pressed the right arrow or made a mistake .
💎 At the end of each battle the administrator will see the rating table.
Give gifts! Each participant will receive 20% of the value of each gift.
Move in rhythm, click on the arrows ⬆️⬅️⬇️➡️, keep up, stay focused, earn rating, get gifts while dancing and be a star🌟!  

Attention! The administrator of the game can not participate in the battle.

we are going to be bringing in new improvements

Enjoy you time at Lovecraft and you will see you around
